s: Merry's Acorn
A small acorn, warm as a held hand. "The key to my secret place."
Thorne's Writ
"The girl is to be detained and conveyed to the Cathedral of Dawn. Unharmed." Sealed in black wax.
MAG +4, RES +4, MP +10%. Inscribed inside: "Keep the light."
Pell's Horseshoe
LCK +10, DEF +4. The third horseshoe from over the Pell farmhouse door.
Cliff Kite
Rides the Gale like a thrown knife. Nests in the cliffs and resents everyone below them.
A crab that took one look at the Gale and grew a boulder on its back.
Spume Jelly
Sea-foam that learned to hold a grudge. Spits salt in your eyes.
The Lord-Commander's personal guard. Black trim, a sun with a closed eye, and orders they will not explain.
Mourning Moth
They drink tears. In the Whisperwold they never go thirsty.
Hollow Sapling
A young tree with a hollow where its heart should be. Something whispers in the hollow.
Lost Shade
It is saying something. It has been saying it for a hundred years. It no longer knows to whom.
The oldest tree in the Whisperwold. She gathered the voices of the dead into her hollow so that none of them would ever be forgotten — or ever be allowed to end.
Three generations of Pells built him. One sack of cheap purple stuffing woke him up.
Bandit Bruiser
Red Tam hires by the pound.
Tam's Mastiff
Answers to "Biscuit." Do not call it Biscuit.
Quarry stone that soaked up the violet seam beneath it, and got up.
Bethan, the Crestless Sage
Mender, Arcanist, Ranger, Cantor, Pugilist. "Same old woman. Different tools."
"Stay... stay... STAY."
Her bark splits wide open. A hundred voices weep at once!
"Come back to me, little ones..."
The Hollow Mother draws every voice in the wold into her branches...
Old Strawman bursts into violet flame!
crows${Math.floor(c.turn / 3)}
Old Strawman flaps its sleeves. Crows pour out of its coat!
Violet dust gathers in Old Strawman's stitched grin...
Bethan's Crest shifts — ${BETHAN_CRESTS[phase]}!
Harbor town of the Gale Coast. Sailors, smugglers, and the Salt & Lantern.
An ancient forest where the trees speak with the voices of the dead.
A farming village of beehives and autumn fields. Home of the Crestless Sage.
